h2_rule: exposure = share of units in 2-19 unit buildings x share of units built before 1980 (county); flag if >= median across the cities
h3_rule: gap unless data/policy_rules.csv lists an in_force cooling rule with covers_small_mixed_use yes/partial
shortfall_formula: (T_hot_new - T_in) / (T_hot_design - T_in) - 1; steady-state, ignores sun, people, equipment and humidity
